descriptor: Lab of the middle half (25% trimmed per side) of the box crop; float32 BGR/255 through cv2.COLOR_BGR2Lab; set color is the mean of its crops' colors

data.same_split: taught shots (instance galleries) vs later crops, frame > teaching_half_end_frame; triples are non-overlapping runs of 3
data.lookalike_split: taught shots vs up to 6 triples of every other instance of the kind (bench/embed_arms.py same_pairs windows)
